name: negate_counters_noncreature_spell
notes: P0e39720e5e G4. Printed: 'Counter target noncreature spell.' Seat 0 casts Disfigure (an instant) at seat 1's 2/2 Bear. The response window asks seat 1, who holds Negate and exactly {1}{U}; it casts Negate on Disfigure, which is countered (CR 701.5a): its effect never happens, the Bear stays 2/2, both spells end in their owners' graveyards and seat 1's pool is spent.
